_doc: Third-party skills vendored into claude/.claude/skills/ (stowed to ~/.claude/skills/). Each entry names the GitHub source, the path inside it, the commit it was taken at, and the license. `claude-tooling-sync update-skills [name]` re-fetches at the source's default branch and rewrites `commit`; `verify` checks each directory exists and carries a SKILL.md. Skills authored on this workstation are not listed here.

daisyui._why: The official daisyUI skill, one guide per component; the reference every implementer and reviewer reads before touching DaisyUI markup.

golang-spf13-cobra._why: Cobra command-tree conventions for the planned cairn Go tool; go-conventions and elm-conventions stay mandatory beside it.

vale-ci._why: Vale's official skills, vendored instead of the plugin because the plugin's edit hook duplicates the workstation vale-hook.
